title: Playground Static Iframe Sites
description: All playgrounds build to static iframe-embeddable sites. Latest canonical hosts in repo CNAME files; versioned subdomains (v{n}.play…) deployed outside git.
summary: Unified playground static-site contract: base ./, public/.nojekyll + CNAME per play, frame-ancestors * for iframe embed, shared createPlaygroundPlayViteConfig preset. Hosts: play.semio-tech.com (sketchpad), play.cad/2d/3d/5d.semio-tech.com. Versioned v{n}.* deployed at release, repo keeps latest only. CI workflow play-sites.yml builds all five. Tests 15/15; verified 2d + cad dist artifacts.
